up: Retrieve activity measurements for assay CHEMBL4649942. Return the canonical SMILES, chembl_id, standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units for each compound. Filter the results to include only rows where the standard value is non-null and the standard relation is exactly '='.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.standard_relation, act.standard_value, act.standard_units FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno WHERE a.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649942' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL
